data.name: hakoniwa code
data.detailed_description:
This is a 3D action game where you clear stages by using programming.

Players use their own programs and autonomous robots to overcome obstacles, defeat enemies, and conquer each stage.

You can also modify stages and build your own original world with your unique programs.

Programming Features

The game includes a dedicated programming editor with an intuitive interface, allowing players to create their own programs.

These custom programs can be used in the actual stages, greatly expanding the range of strategic possibilities.

For example, you can:

  • Combine blocks to build autonomous defensive walls that protect against enemy attacks

  • Generate blocks in mid-air and apply force to destroy obstacles

  • Construct structures that support movement, allowing players to quickly reach advantageous positions

Player Actions

Controllable characters have only two core actions: "movement" and "program execution."

Although simple at first glance, when combined with powerful programming capabilities, these actions unlock endless tactical possibilities.

For instance:

  • Draw enemy attention with your character to keep your autonomous robots safe

  • Use the environment strategically to position robots effectively

  • Efficiently collect experience items dropped by defeated enemies

World Expansion & Sharing

In sandbox stages, players can unleash their creativity and design their own worlds using custom algorithms and logic.

Examples include:

  • Filling an empty space with lush vegetation

  • Generating unpredictable structures using random numbers and conditions

  • Modifying completed stages to create brand-new challenges

Additionally, custom programs and modified stages can be shared with other players using the built-in sharing feature.

Your creativity might become someone else's new adventure.
